name: Volcanoes of Kamchatka
description: On Russia's remote Kamchatka Peninsula, this group of six protected areas covers much of a volcanic belt of around 160 volcanoes, 29 of them still active. Steaming cones rise above glaciers, creating a landscape of fire and ice. Brown bears, sea otters, Steller's sea eagles and an unmatched variety of salmon-family fish thrive here.
